experiment: Experiment 13 — MSDF BackgroundOnly Residual Injection Ablation
only_control_variable: Black final MSDF up-block residual injection gamma: 0 versus 1

generation_protocol.pipeline: StableDiffusionInpaintPipeline; standard inpainting only; no magic/dynamic/task-guidance branches
generation_protocol.safety_checker: disabled for industrial images; no safety-based sample replacement
generation_protocol.generator_device: CPU torch.Generator per slot; freshly seeded; record before/after state hashes at future runtime
generation_protocol.output_encoding: lossless RGB PNG for final full canvas; no JPEG re-encoding
generation_protocol.checkpoint: same newly trained V2 class final_step2000 checkpoint across banks, hash bound before ANY sampling

prompts.flash: a photo of a sks flash defect
prompts.black: a photo of a sks black spot defect

geometry_policy.mask: L-mode rectangle, floor(left/top), ceil(right/bottom), exclusive right/bottom
geometry_policy.mask_semantics: white inpaint, black retain; weak bbox geometry NOT segmentation ground truth
geometry_policy.output: paste generated 512 patch into the same full normal canvas at fixed crop origin; ignore padded pixels, no blending or quality selection
geometry_policy.synthetic_labels: only frozen target bbox; background normal has no dataset-defined boxes

raw_output_policy.structural_failure_consequence: stop formal comparison if any frozen slot fails; do not replace it or silently reduce 40/40

evaluation.ROI: bbox plus 25 percent context; frozen floor/ceil clipping
evaluation.Inception: torch-fidelity inception-v3-compat 2048D; float32 extraction; float64 CPU metrics
